official_secure_channel_note: Use only the named official website, secure HTTPS form, verified office phone, or in-person office path for sensitive case details and documents. If the current public instructions do not show a secure submission path, call the responsible election office first before sending records.
minimum_necessary_disclosure_note: Send only the personal information the current official process requires. Do not post or send full Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, dates of birth, confidential residence details, court papers, custody records, or other sensitive identifiers through public, unverified, or generalized channels.
operability_now_note: Before relying on this path under same-day or near-cutoff pressure, verify that the responsible office, portal, site, or delivery route is still open and operating right now using the latest official hours/closure notice, current update page, or verified office phone.
deadline_imminence_note: Do not assume an older FAQ, PDF, screenshot, or cached directory still controls today's path. If the cutoff is near or may already have passed, confirm the current live deadline with the responsible office and pivot immediately to the stated fallback or confirmation path if the original route is no longer operable.
current_official_controls_note: The current directly governing state or local election-office source controls for this case. National routing pages, generalized official explainers, and archive summaries are routing aids only and are not substitutes for the current official instruction that directly governs the voter's jurisdiction and election scope.
superseding_notice_note: Older pages, PDFs, screenshots, packet inserts, or archived summaries may remain visible. Follow the most current official notice, form, correction, update, or replacement instruction and use the dated or last-updated cue when available.
unresolved_conflict_stop_note: If current official materials still materially conflict, disagree, or leave a controlling gap, do not synthesize an answer from fragments. Treat that unresolved conflict as a stop condition and use the responsible official office or help path for case-specific confirmation; move to the rights/safety escalation lane when the conflict is paired with likely wrongful denial, intimidation, discrimination, or unsafe exposure.
residence_rule_summary: A voter living in a covered facility may register from the residence recognized by current public guidance; some facilities also permit proof by staff vouching or facility-issued documents.
proof_or_vouching_summary: Facility staff may vouch on Election Day if the current public rule expressly allows it.
request_trigger_summary: Contact the county elections office or facility coordinator before the published deadline to schedule the named facility-voting model.
assistance_constraints_summary: Only the public rule's permitted assistants, agents, deputies, or supervised-voting teams may help with ballot request, marking, witnessing, pickup, or return.
ballot_return_summary: Return is completed through the named team, designated agent, or ordinary absentee method identified by the current public rule.

facility_models.plain_language: An agent with the required preexisting relationship may pick up and return the ballot materials for the voter under the public rule.
facility_models.residence_rule_summary: Use the residence recognized by the jurisdiction's current facility-voting guidance.
facility_models.proof_or_vouching_rule: Use the proof or certification named in the public rule for covered facilities.
facility_models.request_trigger: The voter files the current absentee or application form and names the authorized agent before the deadline.
facility_models.ballot_marking_assistance_rule: Assistance is limited to the persons allowed by current public guidance.
facility_models.ballot_return_rule: The authorized agent returns the materials to the named elections office.
facility_models.witness_or_team_rule: Any witness requirement follows the current absentee rule unless the public facility model says otherwise.
facility_models.facility_contact_rule: Contact the county elections office if facility staff cannot verify the correct path.

facility_models.plain_language: A bipartisan or supervised team visits the facility and jointly oversees ballot delivery and voting under the public rule.
facility_models.residence_rule_summary: The facility or prior residence address is used as stated in current public guidance.
facility_models.proof_or_vouching_rule: Use the public proof, roster, or vouching rule for the covered facility type.
facility_models.request_trigger: The facility administrator or county office schedules the visit using the published process.
facility_models.ballot_marking_assistance_rule: The voter may receive help only from persons allowed by the public rule.
facility_models.ballot_return_rule: The supervised-voting team or clerk returns the ballot as directed by current public guidance.
facility_models.witness_or_team_rule: The public rule states whether the visit must be bipartisan or otherwise specially staffed.
facility_models.facility_contact_rule: The facility uses the named county board, clerk, or supervisor contact to schedule the visit.

facility_models.plain_language: A staff member from a covered residential facility may vouch for Election Day proof of residence if the public rule expressly allows it.
facility_models.residence_rule_summary: The facility residence is used for district assignment under the current public rule.
facility_models.proof_or_vouching_rule: The authorized staff vouches in the manner stated on the public registration guidance.
facility_models.request_trigger: This model activates when the voter registers or corrects residence on site under the Election Day rule.
facility_models.ballot_marking_assistance_rule: Ballot-marking assistance follows the general accessibility or absentee assistance rule unless a specific facility model controls.
facility_models.ballot_return_rule: Return follows the ordinary in-person or absentee path unless the facility model states otherwise.
facility_models.witness_or_team_rule: No deputy or supervised team is required unless separately named.
facility_models.facility_contact_rule: Contact the local elections office if staff are unsure whether the facility qualifies for vouching.

help_paths.label: County board, clerk, or supervisor facility-voting desk
help_paths.use_when: The voter, family member, or facility administrator needs to verify the covered-facility rule or schedule the public assistance model.

help_paths.label: Designated facility voting coordinator
help_paths.contact_value: Administrator or social-work contact designated by the facility
help_paths.use_when: The voter needs the current handout, scheduling instructions, or the office to call for supervised/deputized assistance.
